an10.20:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsadhammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo
an10.20:1.2: tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi …pe… bhagavā etadavoca
an10.20:2.1: dasayime bhikkhave ariyavāsā ye ariyā āvasiṃsu vā āvasanti vā āvasissanti vā
an10.20:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti chaḷaṅgasamannāgato ekārakkho caturāpasseno panuṇṇapaccekasacco samavayasaṭṭhesano anāvilasaṅkappo passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro suvimuttacitto suvimuttapañño.
an10.20:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno kāmacchando pahīno hoti byāpādo pahīno hoti thīnamiddhaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti vicikicchā pahīnā hoti
an10.20:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti.
an10.20:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā neva sumano hoti na dummano upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno
an10.20:4.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya neva sumano hoti na dummano upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno
an10.20:4.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu chaḷaṅgasamannāgato hoti.
an10.20:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satārakkhena cetasā samannāgato hoti
an10.20:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ekārakkho hoti.
an10.20:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saṅkhāyekaṃ paṭisevati saṅkhāyekaṃ adhivāseti saṅkhāyekaṃ parivajjeti saṅkhāyekaṃ vinodeti
an10.20:6.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu caturāpasseno hoti.
an10.20:7.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ puthupaccekasaccāni seyyathīdaṃ
an10.20:7.3: sassato lokoti vā asassato lokoti vā antavā lokoti vā anantavā lokoti vā taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti vā hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā
an10.20:7.4: sabbāni tāni nuṇṇāni honti panuṇṇāni cattāni vantāni muttāni pahīnāni paṭinissaṭṭhāni
an10.20:7.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu panuṇṇapaccekasacco hoti.
an10.20:8.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno kāmesanā pahīnā hoti bhavesanā pahīnā hoti brahmacariyesanā paṭippassaddhā
an10.20:8.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano hoti.
an10.20:9.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno kāmasaṅkappo pahīno hoti byāpādasaṅkappo pahīno hoti vihiṃsāsaṅkappo pahīno hoti
an10.20:9.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu anāvilasaṅkappo hoti.
an10.20:10.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an10.20:10.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu passaddhakāyasaṃkhāro hoti.
an10.20:11.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti
an10.20:11.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu suvimuttacitto hoti.
an10.20:12.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu rāgo me pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃ kato āyatiṃanuppādadhammoti pajānāti doso me pahīno …pe… moho me pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃ kato āyatiṃanuppādadhammoti pajānāti
an10.20:12.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu suvimuttapañño hoti.
an10.20:13.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave atītamaddhānaṃ ariyā ariyavāse āvasiṃsu sabbe te imeva dasa ariyavāse āvasiṃsu
an10.20:13.2: ye hi keci bhikkhave anāgatamaddhānaṃ ariyā ariyavāse āvasissanti sabbe te imeva dasa ariyavāse āvasissanti
an10.20:13.3: ye hi keci bhikkhave etarahi ariyā ariyavāse āvasanti sabbe te imeva dasa ariyavāse āvasanti
an10.20:13.4: ime kho bhikkhave dasa ariyavāsā ye ariyā āvasiṃsu vā āvasanti vā āvasissanti vāti.
